name: Editor
purpose: Rich text editor with a minimal self-contained contentEditable kernel and a formatting toolbar.

label.description: Accessible label for the editable region.

onChange.description: Called with the current HTML on every edit.

boldLabel.description: Accessible label for the bold command.

italicLabel.description: Accessible label for the italic command.

states.name: empty
states.description: Editor ready and empty; placeholder visible.

antiPatterns: Do not inject unsanitized HTML into the editable region.
Do not use the editor as a code editor; use CodeBlock or a dedicated control.

a11y.focus: Editable region is focusable with aria-multiline; toolbar buttons precede it.
a11y.labeling: aria-label names the editor; toolbar buttons expose command names.

responsive.strategy: Full width editing surface; toolbar wraps on compact.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir.
